name: context-guard
description: Session handoff (/context-guard:handoff), a handoff reminder and auto-compact by context fill, usage limits on the status line, and a token ceiling for subagents

reminder_enabled.title: Handoff reminder
reminder_enabled.description: Show a band and a notification when the main conversation passes the reminder threshold

reminder_percent.title: Handoff reminder threshold (%)
reminder_percent.description: Context fill, as a percentage of the model's window, at which the reminder shows

compact_enabled.title: Auto-compact
compact_enabled.description: Compact the main conversation when it passes the compaction threshold

compact_percent.title: Auto-compact threshold (%)
compact_percent.description: Context fill, as a percentage of the model's window, at which the main conversation is compacted

models.title: Models for reminder and auto-compact
models.description: Comma-separated fragments of model ids the reminder and auto-compact apply to (e.g. opus,sonnet); empty means every model

usage_band.title: Usage line above the prompt
usage_band.description: Show context fill and the 5-hour and weekly usage limits in the band above the prompt (terminal)

usage_status.title: Usage status line
usage_status.description: Show the same usage line on the status line under the prompt (terminal only)

limit_warn_percent.title: Usage limit warning (%)
limit_warn_percent.description: Post a notice in the chat once a 5-hour or weekly usage limit reaches this percentage; 0 turns it off

status_file.title: Status file for VS Code
status_file.description: Write each session's context fill and usage limits to ~/.claude/context-guard/sessions/ for the Context Guard VS Code extension

delegation_guidance.title: Subagent sizing guidance
delegation_guidance.description: Tell the orchestrator (the models for reminder and auto-compact) to split work into small capped subagents that fit their room, and tell each capped subagent its budget and to carry on after a compaction

subagent_cap_enabled.title: Subagent token ceiling
subagent_cap_enabled.description: Cut oversized tool results in subagents so their requests stay under the token ceiling

subagent_cap_tokens.title: Subagent token ceiling (tokens)
subagent_cap_tokens.description: Ceiling for a capped subagent's request; Claude Haiku 5.5 bills 5x past 100000

subagent_compact_tokens.title: Subagent compaction point (tokens)
subagent_compact_tokens.description: Where Claude Code compacts a capped subagent: settings modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow less its 33000 buffer (128000 gives 95000). A tool result that fits after that compaction is not cut

subagent_cap_models.title: Subagent ceiling models
subagent_cap_models.description: Comma-separated fragments of model ids the subagent ceiling applies to; empty means every model
